title: feat(ui)!: a record opened from a list opens in the drawer by default, and the split pane retires
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbRZcEuiZXb12Z9xsrdSrjyJ)_

Fixes #28915

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：从列表打开记录，默认改为右侧抽屉，列表保持全宽、所有列都在；分屏模式整体退役。Display 菜单「打开记录」只剩「抽屉」和「整页」两个选项。
- **为什么改**：维护者裁定「默认改抽屉，分屏彻底退役，只留抽屉和整页」。分屏把列表挤成三列或卡片，读起来比抽屉差。
- **风险与回滚**：读者此前存的 `split` 偏好会按默认（抽屉）读出，不做兼容读；`@object-ui/components` 移除了分屏相关的 7 个导出（BREAKING，changeset 写明迁移）。回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据或元数据迁移。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx`（分屏外观与 Esc 处理的删除）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`（去掉 drawer→split 的映射）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordOpenPreference.ts`（偏好只认 drawer / page）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm dev:crm` 打开 Accounts 列表，点一行：记录在右侧抽屉打开，列表不变窄；打开右上 Display 菜单，「打开记录」只有 Drawer 和 Full page。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A record opened from a list now opens in the non-modal drawer over the list by default, and the list keeps its full width and every view column. The split pane beside the list retires: a record opens only as the drawer or as the full page.

- `recordOpenPreference.ts`: `RecordOpenPreference` is `'drawer' | 'page'`, default `drawer`. A stored `split` is an unknown value and reads as the default, with no compatibility read.
- `ObjectView.tsx`: the drawer-to-split mapping is gone; the overlay receives the resolved mode as is. The record-count bar beside the pane (`RecordPaneListCount`) goes with it.
- `navigation-overlay.tsx`: `NavigationOverlayMode` is `page | drawer | new_window | none`. Removed: the split face, `RECORD_SPLIT_MIN_CONTENT_PX`, the width probe, `useSplitEscape`, `paneBeside` and the narrowed list face. The list under the drawer renders full width inside the active-row provider and goes inert while the drawer is maximized. Kept as they were: the non-modal drawer, a row click swapping the record, the stepper, drag-to-resize, maximize in place, and the modal sheet for a drawer with no list.
- `record-list-face.tsx` and `custom/index.ts`: the narrowed-face API leaves (`RecordListFaceProvider`, `useRecordListFace`, `recordListFaceFor`, `RECORD_LIST_CARD_FACE_BELOW_PX`, `RECORD_LIST_NARROW_COLUMN_COUNT`, `RecordListFace`); the active-row store stays.
- `ObjectGrid.tsx`: no three-column or compact-card narrowing beside a pane; the grid draws every view column.
- `ListView.tsx`: the record-count bar always prints its count; the `list.recordOpenSplit` default is gone.
- `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx`: the Open records control has two segments, Drawer and Full page; `selectPage` is gone from the host prop.
- i18n: `list.recordOpenSplit` leaves all ten packs.
- Docs: `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-view.mdx` (the record drawer section) and `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` (the Open records paragraph).
- Changeset `.changeset/28915-record-open-drawer-default.md`: BREAKING, FROM-TO for each of the seven retired exports, ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (runtime-export-retired ...)`.

## Why

Maintainer ruling on #28915: 「默认应该是普通列表，右侧弹出。drawer」 and 「默认改抽屉，分屏彻底退役，只留抽屉和整页，立卡。」 This supersedes #27545's Target item 1 and the split half of its item 2.

## Tests

The #27545 split tests are converted to the drawer, not deleted:

- `navigation-overlay-split-27545` becomes `navigation-overlay-drawer-27545` (drawer over the list, list full width, ✕ closes, retired exports absent from the module).
- `ObjectView.recordPaneV4-27545` becomes `ObjectView.recordDrawer-27545` (all five columns kept, stored `split` reads as drawer, list inert while maximized).
- `ListView.recordPaneCount-27545` becomes `ListView.recordDrawerCount-27545`; `ObjectGrid.recordPaneFace-27545` becomes `ObjectGrid.recordDrawerList-27545`.
- Updated to the drawer: `navigation-overlay-field-escape-28156`, `navigation-overlay-close-i18n`, `chrome-i18n-no-provider-fallback`, `record-top-bar-27524`, `record-list-face-27545`, `RecordPageColumns.enlargedEscapeInPane-27524`, `recordOpenPreference.test.ts`, `ObjectView.recordOpenPreference-26677`, `ObjectView.recordOpenDisplay-26681`, `ObjectView.recordCountFooter-10636`, `objectListTitle-27950`, `titleViewSwitcher-27594`, `viewRefusal-12112`, `phoneRecordPage-27058`, `RecordDetailView.topBar-27524`, `ViewSettingsPopover.recordOpen-26681`.

Ablation: decoding a stored `split` as `page` instead of the default turns `recordOpenPreference.test.ts` red (1 failed); restored, tree byte-identical to HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

**Screenshots** (examples/app-crm, Accounts, sidebar open; at 1000 px the sidebar is pinned open with Keep sidebar open, since the console folds it to a rail below 1416 px):

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| 1440, record open | split pane, list narrowed to 3 columns | drawer over the full-width list |
| 1000, record open | drawer (split fell back for want of width) | drawer over the full-width list |
| Display menu, Open records | Split / Drawer / Full page | Drawer / Full page |

The 12 files are in the project files under `issue-28915/shots/` (`before-` and `after-`, `1440-` and `1000-`, `list`, `display-menu`, `record-open`).

**Premise reading, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/consoleSidebarRail.ts` (read-only here).** `CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_RAIL_BELOW_WIDTH` is 1416 px, derived only from split content: `RECORD_SPLIT_MIN_CONTENT_WIDTH = 440 + 720` plus the 256 px expanded sidebar. With the split pane retired that derivation has no remaining reason. The fold itself still has one: #27593 quotes the maintainer 「窄屏幕左侧菜单自动折叠，点击弹出」 with an original target near 1100 px. So the threshold, not the fold, is left without a reason. Out-of-scope finding, carrier: seat.

**Other out-of-scope findings (carrier: seat):**

- Stale split-pane comments outside the declared surface: `record-top-bar.tsx:11`, `data-table.tsx:3735`, plugin-detail `RecordPageColumns.tsx:135/237`, `useRecordPageTier.ts:31`, `synth/recordPageColumns.ts:16/93/110`, react `useNavigationOverlay.ts:278`, plugin-view `ObjectView.tsx:590/1193`, `RecordDetailView.tsx:943/1003`, `objectViewOpenAsPage.tsx:15`, `appObjectScope.ts:45`, `ObjectGrid.tsx:3202`.
- The `console.objectView.recordCount` key family is now read by no source file, and the overlay no longer reads `common.closePanel`.
- Skills follow-up: `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` (line 48) and `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json` (line 24) still say split is the default; `skills/**` is outside this card.

**Deviations:** `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` (one paragraph) is outside the declared file surface, a bounded in-place fix of the same claim; the plugin-detail and `RecordDetailView.topBar` test files are touched because they drove the split mode. Four test files are renamed. The dogfood battery ran as four `vitest --shard` legs because one foreground call is capped at 600 s; the legs cover all 387 files.
